const crypto = require("crypto"); class IdentityEngine { constructor() { this.users = new Map(); this.orgs = new Map(); this.teams = new Map(); } createOrganization(name, ownerId) { const orgId = "org_" + crypto.randomBytes(8).toString("hex"); const org = { id: orgId, name, ownerId, createdAt: Date.now() }; this.orgs.set(orgId, org); return org; } createUser(email, name, password) { const userId = "usr_" + crypto.randomBytes(8).toString("hex"); const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex"); const hash = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, 1000, 64, "sha512").toString("hex"); const user = { id: userId, email, name, salt, hash, createdAt: Date.now() }; this.users.set(userId, user); return { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name }; } authenticate(email, password) { const user = Array.from(this.users.values()).find(u => u.email === email); if (!user) return null; const verifyHash = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, user.salt, 1000, 64, "sha512").toString("hex"); if (user.hash === verifyHash) { return { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name }; } return null; } } module.exports = IdentityEngine;

const crypto = require("crypto"); class EnterpriseAuth { constructor(secret = "ade_enterprise_production_secret_key_2026") { this.secret = secret; this.revokedTokens = new Set(); } generateJWT(payload, expiresInMs = 3600000) { const header = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ alg: "HS256", typ: "JWT" })).toString("base64url"); const body = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ ...payload, exp: Date.now() + expiresInMs, iat: Date.now() })).toString("base64url"); const signature = crypto.createHmac("sha256", this.secret).update(header + "." + body).digest("base64url"); return header + "." + body + "." + signature; } verifyJWT(token) { if (this.revokedTokens.has(token)) return { valid: false, error: "REVOKED_TOKEN" }; const parts = token.split("."); if (parts.length !== 3) return { valid: false, error: "MALFORMED_TOKEN" }; const [header, body, signature] = parts; const expectedSig = crypto.createHmac("sha256", this.secret).update(header + "." + body).digest("base64url"); if (signature !== expectedSig) return { valid: false, error: "INVALID_SIGNATURE" }; const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(body, "base64url").toString("utf8")); if (Date.now() > payload.exp) return { valid: false, error: "TOKEN_EXPIRED" }; return { valid: true, payload }; } revokeToken(token) { this.revokedTokens.add(token); } generateAPIKey(prefix = "ade_live_") { const rawKey = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString("hex"); const hashedKey = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(rawKey).digest("hex"); return { apiKey: prefix + rawKey, keyHash: hashedKey }; } } module.exports = EnterpriseAuth;
